items.name: Recognition Threshold
items.text:
Per the Recognition Threshold, only Pro/Ent plans are recognized, and only Yearly/Multi-yearly.

(Optional) Please keep the Opp and cc claim as is. This accumulates ARR while you own the Account, and if there is an upgrade (to Pro/Ent or to Yearly/Multi-Yearly) within your Account Ownership, you will be recognized for all the accumulated ARR + claimed ARR in the Opp for the upgrade.

You can see more on the new ARR Recognition Threshold policy here:
• https://monday.monday.com/boards/3047308442/pulses/7085940202
• https://monday.monday.com/boards/3047308442/pulses/7156763658

Let me know if you have any other questions. 

-- OR --

"This Account is not meeting the criteria as they are still on only [Standard Tier OR Monthly Plan]. The ARR here won't be lost as long as you claimed it - it will be banked and added to subsequent opportunities until one matches the recognition criteria, at which point you will be recognised for the full amount claimed to date." (Response here)

items.text:

items.name: Submit OPT OUT request
items.text:
The "Submit Opt-Out Request" button can be found on the Opportunity page via the dropdown menu on the top right side.
Please follow these steps to ensure a smooth approval process:
1. Select the Correct Opt-Out Type
You will need to select the appropriate opt-out lane. Please double-check this, as Finance will strictly validate it:

* Contractual
* Non-Contractual
2. Escalation Process (For Non-Contractual Requests Only)
f you select Non-Contractual, the approval process requires an extra step once it passes your 3rd-line manager. When the request reaches the "Pending CCO Approval" stage, you must open a Slack group with Mary Malinsky and Adi Dar.

:bulb: Important Update: Please create this Slack group directly through the "Slack Channel" tab within the Salesforce Opportunity. When creating the channel, please provide the following details:

* Reason / Root Cause: Why is this request being made (e.g., product gap, budget change, implementation issue)?
* Requested Outcome: What is the expected outcome (full churn or a specific exception)?
* Retention Efforts: What actions have been taken to retain the customer or remediate the situation?
* Justification: Why should this request be approved as an exception to standard policy?
* Supporting Context: Summary of key points from your conversations (link documentation if needed).

:warning: Critical Commercial Details to Include:
How much loss (ARR/revenue) can we expect?
What are their current commercials right now?
How long have they been a customer with us?
When is their upcoming renewal?
How many days past their previous renewal are they currently? Next Steps & Business Lounge
Please note that you should only open a Business Lounge ticket for further support after the request has been fully approved by Mary Malinsky and Adi Dar in the Slack group, and subsequently approved within the Salesforce opt-out request on the opportunity.
Let me know if you run into any issues finding the button or if you need further clarification!

items.text:
Unfortunately this opportunity is not eligible to be recognised at this point in time.

For partner opportunities, the ARR compared against the threshold is based only on the claimed ARR, not the account ARR at present. In this case, there has not been enough ARR claimed on this account by the partner to meet the threshold, so the opportunity cannot be recognised.

Don't worry; the amount here will be added to future opportunities, and when the total meets the threshold, the full amount will be recognised
